intro.text: A listener warrior on the Shattered Plains, trained with both Shardblade and Shardplate. Eshonai considers him the best candidate for her Shards should she die.
A listener who refused stormform and, as one of the Five, leads the listeners who escaped into the chasms of the Shattered Plains.
A listener Willshaper and a member of the first Council of Five of the new listener nation on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Thude was born into the First-Rhythm family and spent much of his youth working the fields and chopping wood. He became friends with Eshonai and Bila early on.

When Venli went into a storm, Thude argued with Eshonai that she must be becoming a mate, and admitted that he wanted to ask Bila to take mateform with him. When the Five tested Venli's theory for finding warform, Thude was one of the dozen listeners who managed to take the form, and he went with Eshonai to face a rival family attacking theirs.
After the Alethi armies came to the Shattered Plains, Thude asked Eshonai whether the listeners could even win the war. At some point, he and Bila spent two weeks in mateform together.

Thude fought in many great battles, including the Battle of the Tower. He arranged a parley with the Alethi on the orders of the Five. When Eshonai returned from a highstorm in a new form, he was horrified, told her the form was wrong, and opposed her seizing control. She put him in charge of the listeners who refused the form.

Thude led the listeners who had refused stormform in escaping into the chasms, where chasmfiends helped them, and they roamed the Plains for over a year. When a group of singers approached, he mistook Venli for Eshonai. Wary of her, he still let her see her mother, showed her a chasmfiend, and allowed the singers, including five Fused who had rejected Odium, to stay.
Thude bonded one of the Radiant spren Venli brought and became a Willshaper.

With Jaxlim and Venli, Thude asked the Fused Leshwi to reject Odium and join the listeners. He sang Venli the Song of the Beasts, which he had composed, but he and the Five opposed her idea of joining the Coalition. During a highstorm, the Stone spoke to him, telling him to seek the centre of Narak.

The Five set out for the centre with chasmfiends, the Fused and some fifteen listeners. On the way, Venli told Thude that Eshonai hadn't belonged to Odium when she died, which made him somewhat happier. He insisted they stay out of the fighting at Narak, as they couldn't afford more losses.

Venli opened a tunnel beneath the plateau, and Thude, the Five and Venli found a large pool of golden light. Thude foolishly reached out to touch it before Bila stopped him. Then a guard brought word that their Fused had been discovered.

Fused carried the listeners to El, commander of Odium's forces at Narak, who offered to spare them if they and their chasmfiends fought for him. Thude was set on refusing, even though it likely meant death, until Venli devised a cunning plan.

Through Venli, the Five secretly agreed a treaty with the Alethi giving the Shattered Plains to the listeners. Telling El they had accepted his offer, the listeners rode their chasmfiends against the human fortress in a staged attack, letting the Alethi pass Venli the signed treaty. Thude greatly enjoyed 'destroying' as much as possible.
Afterwards, El ordered Thude to guard the Oathgate from another plateau. Thude said the chasmfiends wouldn't move any more, and El agreed to let them watch from where they were.

Once the contest of champions had frozen the borders, Thude showed El the treaty with Queen Jasnah and formally asked him to withdraw from the Plains. Bound by Odium's promise, El agreed. Thude became a member of the first Council of Five of the new listener nation.

appearance.text: Like all singers, Thude's appearance depends on his form. In warform, his favourite, he is tall and thick-limbed. His skin always has a pattern of large marbled patches, and he tends to wear a long coat, though Bila mocks it.

personality.text: For most of his life, Thude was jovial and content, but the war with the Alethi took its toll and he grew solemn, worried for his people's survival. He loves food and uses eating as an excuse to end arguments.
